# Unity Compass

> Unity Compass LLC is a United States government contracting consulting and staffing firm based in Frederick, Maryland.

Canonical website: https://unitycompass.com/
Contact: https://unitycompass.com/contact
About: https://unitycompass.com/about-us
Editorial policy: https://unitycompass.com/editorial-policy
Capability statement: https://unitycompass.com/documents/capability-statement.pdf

## Core services

- Federal proposal development and capture support: https://unitycompass.com/proposal-development-services
- Security-cleared and non-cleared recruitment: https://unitycompass.com/recruitment-services
- Contract, direct-hire, and temp-to-hire staffing: https://unitycompass.com/staffing
- Information technology and business consulting: https://unitycompass.com/information-technology-and-business-consulting
- Customized operational and compliance support: https://unitycompass.com/customized-support-services
